t_advice_summary_textbox.text: I should do my best to learn the gnome colours because different colour gnomes have an impact on the amount of points I will get from a basket.

vb_textbox.text: The advice I was given was to pay attention to the Gnome colours. I think this is partly correct - It seems to me that the basket colour is more important.In the later parts of the experiment , I instead tried to focus on getting red baskets, which certain colours of gnomes will result in you getting. (Red , Blue, Brown Gnomes would give Red consistently)Red seemed to be consistently better for me at giving higher points combinations. As opposed to Yellow. Good luck !
